scripts.build:windows: bun src-sqlite-extension/build.ts --skip-linux && neu build --embed-resources && bun run cleanup:mac
scripts.build: bun src-sqlite-extension/build.ts && neu build --embed-resources && bun run cleanup:mac
scripts.cleanup:mac: bun -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('dist/myapp')) { fs.readdirSync('dist/myapp').filter(f => f.includes('-mac_')).forEach(f => { fs.unlinkSync('dist/myapp/' + f); console.log('🗑️ Deleted macOS binary:', f) }) }"
